text:
lara: flagged by billing: a handful of high-volume calls from customer 444 were billed to org root during last night's deploy window. digging in now.
pavan: timeframe? did we roll the auth-normalizer change?
lara: deploy timestamp 2025-11-04T23:04Z. logs show the normalizer dropped `project_id` when introspect returned 5xx. example header seen: `x-origin: org/444` but original inbound had `x-original-origin: org/444/project/99/sa/worker`
joel: that's the normalizer behavior we added to simplify routing: when introspect fails, collapse to org to avoid misrouted tenant traffic. apparently that collapses billing attribution too. not great.
ops-bot: auth-normalizer v1.8 deployed 2025-11-04T22:59Z -> rollout 100% at 23:03Z.
billing: customer ops: saw a +8% tokens delta on org/444. projected invoice variance small but flagged by accounts.
pavan: quick ideas: A) keep header but add certainty flag `x-origin-certainty: uncertain` B) preserve `x-original-origin` but mark it unsigned C) revert normalizer immediately.
lara: C is invasive. A or B are safer. if we preserve `x-original-origin` we need to avoid honoring unverified values for access decisions. so only billing/telemetry should read it.
joel: agree. we can emit `auth.origin_certainty=unverified_introspect` in telemetry and add `x-origin-preserved: true` header for downstream processing.
billing: for accounting rules: prefer the most specific asserted identity. If asserted=false, bill org but flag invoices with `attribution_uncertain=true`. finance will review weekly.
devex: console UX ask: surface a per-customer switch "Require asserted project attribution" that rejects requests with uncertain attribution (returns 403) and another toggle "Show uncertain attributions" that adds the badge. Customers like Dedicated can enable stricter enforcement.
pavan: also need security rules: only accept `x-original-origin` if it comes from a trusted proxy or the header is signed. Joel, can normalizer sign preserved headers?
joel: yes, can HMAC sign using proxy key; downstream services verify signature against known keys per-region. will add tests.
lara: telemetry: add `auth.attribution_path: collapsed_on_introspect_error` and `billing.attribution_uncertain_count`. make sure dashboards can filter by these values.
billing: add a backfill job to scan logs for the window and produce correction reports; we won't auto-bill adjustments but will notify accounts.
pavan: rollout plan: 1) patch normalizer to preserve original header + add `x-origin-certainty` and signed token, 2) staging smoke, 3) canary 5% with billing signal monitor, 4) full roll. schedule patch for tonight?
joel: I can cut a PR in the next hour. will include header signing and verification and a feature flag `preserve_origin_on_introspect_error`.
devex: console work: will wire the toggle to a per-account flag `require_asserted_origin` and add badge column `uncertain_attributions` in the traffic table. need API changes to surface the new telemetry counts.
lara: tests: add e2e that simulates introspect 5xx and validates preserved header is signed and that billing sees `uncertain` tag.
ops-bot: rollout checklist created: PR -> unit tests -> staging -> canary 5% -> monitor 24h -> 50% -> 100%.
billing: please add a quick support note for accounts so front-line can triage customer inquiries if they pop.
pavan: FYI: we should also review rate-limit crediting logic because some quota enforcement uses origin for per-project caps. uncertain attribution could allow traffic to dodge project caps.
joel: good call. we'll add a gate: if `x-origin-certainty=uncertain` then enforce org-level caps and do not credit project caps automatically. add telemetry event if request would have hit project cap but was applied at org.
lara: ok locking on that. pinging infra for key rotation schedule and a CIDR allowlist for header acceptance. will follow up with PR link.
pavan: thanks everyone.
